notes:
Fixes the bug behind documents vanishing from the binder while their file sat safely on disk. A project's structure and its search index could end up disagreeing about which document was which, and once they did, moving that document stopped working and it fell out of view. The project's own structure is now the answer both of them use, and affected projects repair themselves the next time you open them — nothing is lost.

- A document moved into a folder could stop being found by search, because its entry still pointed at the folder it came from. Those entries now follow the file, and existing ones are corrected when the project opens.
- Fixed a Windows bug that could lose an edit Corylus had just merged, because the editor kept showing the old text and the next automatic save wrote it back.
- Trashed folders and images are reachable again.
- Cloud sync no longer stores anything machine-specific inside the project folder, so another computer's search index or sync bookkeeping cannot overwrite yours.
- "Sync now" publishes this computer's binder structure when the two computers cannot agree which is newer; automatic syncs still leave it alone.
- Your backup folder is remembered per computer instead of travelling with the project.
